title: SPECIAL USE REGULATIONS
previewText: In Special Mixed Use Districts, all uses permitted in the designated Residence District and all uses permitted in the designated M1 District, as set forth in any other provision of this Resolution other than Special Purpose Districts, shall be permitted, except as superseded, modified or supplemented by this Section, inclusive, and Section 123-40 (SIGN REGULATIONS).
